'''Black_wraith Luke's back on Dagobah....again''' is a [[Light]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Black_wraith]]
* '''Published:''' 3 February 2004 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS6]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Mind What You Have Learned / Save You It Can|SE-L-mindwhatyouhavelearned.gif|label=Mind What You Have Learned}}
* '''Starting Interrupt:''' {{CardLink|Podrace Prep|Tat-L-podraceprep.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' Mind What You Have Learned
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:POVS6 MWYHL Black wraith LS 2004 5315.txt |Download]] (omits Yoda (V), Son Of Skywalker (V), Leia (V), 2-1B (Too-Onebee) (V), R2-D2 (Artoo-Detoo) (V), Red 5 (V), Wise Advice, Asteroids Do Not Concern Me (V), Flash Of Insight (V), Sai'torr Kal Fas (V), Bionic Hand (V): no GEMP blueprint)

== Introduction ==

another MWYHL/SYIC deck.

== Notes ==

* Jedi Tests posted as 'Tests 1-6'; dested by number to Great Warrior, A Jedi's Strength, Domain Of Evil, Size Matters Not, It Is The Future You See, You Must Confront Vader.
* Original-era (V) cards dested to the newest printing legal on 2004-02-03: Sai'torr Kal Fas (V) (VS1); Leia (V), R2-D2 (Artoo-Detoo) (V) and Red 5 (V) (VS3); 2-1B (Too-Onebee) (V) (VS4); Yoda (V), Son Of Skywalker (V), Asteroids Do Not Concern Me (V) and Flash Of Insight (V) x2 (VS5); Bionic Hand (V) (VS6). The draft had dropped the (V) on Yoda, 2-1B and Asteroids Do Not Concern Me.
* Posted 'Wise advice' dested the Special Edition Effect, not the Reflections III shield; 'Docking repair' Docking And Repair Facilities; 'HC and the F' Han, Chewie, And The Falcon; 'Luke Reb scout' Luke Skywalker, Rebel Scout; 'Tat-pod arena' Tatooine: Podrace Arena.
* Sites posted as 'Dag- bog clearing' and ditto marks dested to the Dagobah sites (the draft read the ditto Jungle as the generic Jungle). 'Obi’s saber (prem)' and 'Qui’s saber (tat)' dested Obi-Wan's Lightsaber and Qui-Gon Jinn's Lightsaber.

== Strategy ==

before I get started, I’d like to say that yes I know I have no starting effect. This is b/c the only one I have is the Vfrom dag, and I don’t like losing force to play those pretty invisible shields I don’t have.

Anyway, on to the strategy. Get Luke, Yoda, and other stuff w/objective, get Luke started. Start a race when ever viable. Before and after winning the race, get leia, obi, and qui set up at the arena, once Luke is finished pull him of dag and switch him out for the reb scout (so I don’t have to lose to use the upside down card). Set up the asteroid fields around kessel, spread out through the field, drain at kessel and sector while making them lose force to asteroids. oh and by the way leia and the rest, they are to be force draining.That’s basically it, I hope you like this version better.
